title: Senses Working Together Adventure
welcome_lead: Senses don't work alone — they team up. 🎶
meta_desc: The Five Senses Adventure 3 — KS3 Psychology on multisensory perception and synaesthesia.
final_note: You learned how senses combine and met the unusual condition of synaesthesia.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Your brain blends sense data.

Flavour = taste + smell + texture + sight + memory. 🍕

That's why hot chips look, smell and crunch right.

About 4% of people have synaesthesia — senses cross-wire.

  • Hearing music in colours.
  • Tasting words.
  • Seeing numbers with personalities.

It's harmless and often fun. 🌈

Senses adapt — a smell or sound fades when constant.

You stop smelling your own perfume after a few minutes.

Adaptation lets the brain notice new things instead of old ones. 💡
